Maya (Support): FYI escalation from Acme (ticket 23456). They flipped to model=v4.3-quant and are seeing structured-output JSON parsing failures in production. Error: their validator complains about arrays being returned as strings and some required top-level keys missing. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d.

Sam (Eng-ML): Can you paste a minimal request + response? Also confirm whether they used streaming, function-calling, or the JSON-mode flag.

Maya (Support): Minimal repro we got from customer:
```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"v4.3-quant","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Return JSON: {\"items\":[1,2,3],\"id\":\"abc\"}"}],"mode":"json"}'
```
Their service validator fails on the response. Sample response body they pasted: 
```json
{"id":"resp_123","output":"{\"items\":\"[1,2,3]\",\"id\":\"abc\"}"}
```
Note: output.items is a string containing a JSON array ("[1,2,3]") rather than an actual array. Also sometimes response omits "id" at the top level when payloads are chunked.

Sam (Eng-ML): Hmm. That looks like double-encoding where the model/formatter returned a JSON string rather than structured data. Did they use streaming? Chunking can interact with the JSON-mode post-processor.

Maya (Support): They said streaming=false, but they do use relatively long prompts and we hit the new kernel-path for quant inference on their account during the swap.

Nikhil (Eng-Infra): Can we get the full redwood request-id and the node that served it? Also please ask customer to include headers: X-Req-Id and X-Redwood-Debug. Ops-bot, can you pull logs for req_0a1b2c3d?

ops-bot: Logs for req_0a1b2c3d pulled: served-by node-41, model v4.3-quant, runtime=quant-optimized-2, kernel-path=kv-cache-v2. Stack sample: 
```
2025-11-10T14:22:31Z node-41 start req_0a1b2c3d
2025-11-10T14:22:31Z model v4.3-quant selected
2025-11-10T14:22:32Z postprocessor: structured-output v1.4 invoked
2025-11-10T14:22:32Z postprocessor: serialization -> stringified
2025-11-10T14:22:32Z req_0a1b2c3d complete status=200
```

Sam (Eng-ML): That line "postprocessor: serialization -> stringified" is a smoking gun. Looks like the structured-output serializer detected an ambiguous tokenization and fell back to stringifying the whole JSON blob. That fallback behavior changed in the v1.4 postprocessor we rolled with the v4.3-quant model.

Sam (Eng-ML): Short-term mitigation: pin Acme to model=v4.2 (previous variant) or enable the legacy serializer with header `X-Redwood-Serializer: legacy` for their account. Medium-term: revert the postprocessor change and add a regression test that asserts arrays remain typed when mode=json.

Maya (Support): I offered the pin/workaround to the customer and they can flip back immediately. Can we do a quick rollback on the postprocessor change for the global canary?

Nikhil (Eng-Infra): Rolling back the postprocessor change on the canary group now. deploy-bot: trigger rollback tag postproc-v1.3.

ops-bot: rollback started for postproc-v1.3 -> postproc-v1.4 (revert): rollout 10% -> 0%

Sam (Eng-ML): Thanks. Action items:
- Add unit tests that cover array vs string encoding under json mode (Sam)
- Add telemetry alert when postprocessor emits "serialization -> stringified" (Nikhil)
- Add a canary test using real customer prompts to the release pipeline (Maya/Product)

Maya (Support): Customer confirmed after pinning to v4.2 their validator passes. After our rollback completes I'll follow up and close ticket. :white_check_mark:

Nikhil (Eng-Infra): Rollback complete on canary nodes. Monitoring for 15m.

ops-bot: rollout status: 100% revert to postproc-v1.3 on canary pool.

Maya (Support): Customer confirmed both pin and our rollback fixed the issue. They asked for a postmortem and a CVE-style notification for any customers on reserved capacity who might have flipped automatically.

Sam (Eng-ML): Will draft short postmortem. Root cause: postprocessor v1.4 introduced an aggressive stringification fallback when it detected tokenization ambiguities on quant kernels. Regression introduced with the v4.3-quant rollout.

Maya (Support): Filed follow-up ticket #23456-1: add serializer regression tests + account-level serializer header.

Sam (Eng-ML): Also adding a quick smoke check to the model onboarding script: run a small structured-output prompt and assert valid JSON decoding.

Maya (Support): Thanks all. Closing thread when postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
